title: Oyster Cottage Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Incredible construction custom build in 2022 luxury guest cottage in Seaside on Forest Street! Very private, down a footpath, private front porch w/Adirondack seating, and a King primary suite. Luxury touches and designer furnishings throughout.
description_expanded: Description674 FOREST STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAWelcome to Oyster Cottage in Seaside, FloridaNestled in the heart of Seaside, Florida, Oyster Cottage is a newly built luxury beach bungalow thoughtfully designed for comfort, style, and effortless coastal living. This charming guest cottage offers a peaceful retreat just moments from the beach, blending elevated finishes with the relaxed elegance Seaside is known for. A scenic footpath leads to the private front porch, where Adirondack chairs invite you to start your day with coffee or unwind in the evening with a glass of wine, overlooking a tranquil front yard and outdoor grill area.Open-Concept Living with Designer ComfortStep inside to an open and airy floor plan filled with natural light and coastal charm. The living room is beautifully furnished with high-end designer pieces, including a plush queen sleeper sofa for additional guests and a large Smart TV, making it the perfect spot for movie nights or relaxed evenings in. The seamless layout creates an inviting atmosphere ideal for couples or small families seeking a refined Seaside getaway.Chef’s Kitchen Rare for a Guest CottageThe state-of-the-art kitchen is a standout feature rarely found in a Seaside guest cottage. Designed for both beauty and function, it features top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a double-door Sub-Zero refrigerator, stone quartz countertops, a six-burner gas range, farmhouse sink, dishwasher, and generous custom cabinetry. A breakfast bar with seating for four makes casual meals and entertaining effortless, whether you’re preparing beach-day snacks or hosting a cozy dinner at home.Private King Suite & Spa-Inspired BathUpstairs, the luxurious king primary suite serves as a serene private retreat. The spa-like ensuite bathroom includes a deep soaking tub and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with dual rain showerheads, offering a resort-style experience after a day at the beach. Step out onto the private second-floor balcony, where seating for two and peaceful treetop views create the perfect escape for morning relaxation or afternoon downtime. A full washer and dryer are conveniently located on this level for guest use.Ideal Location in the Heart of SeasidePerfect for romantic getaways or young families, Oyster Cottage is within easy walking distance to Seaside’s private beach access, boutique shopping, dining, and iconic town landmarks. For guests traveling with a larger group, the neighboring front cottage, Sea Pearl, a charming two-bedroom home that sleeps five, is also available to rent—offering the perfect opportunity to vacation together while maintaining privacy.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance.FEATURES900 square feet, a larger stand-alone Seaside guest cottage4-minute walk, 352 yards to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest stretch of private residential beach on 30APrimary bathroom with deep soaker tub and rain showerFull-size washer & dryerOutdoor charcoal grillTankless water heaterPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom cottages. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002352
